cohort: The study included 100 cases of placenta previa admitted to the labor room of PMCH, Patna.
finding: The study observed a high prevalence of antepartum hemorrhage (60%) and cesarean deliveries (96%), with common maternal complication of postpartum hemorrhage (33%), and adverse neonatal outcomes including preterm deliveries (54%), low birth weight (35%), and an 8% perinatal mortality rate, where advanced maternal age, multiparity, and prior cesarean deliveries were significant risk factors.
mod_finding: The study found a high prevalence of cesarean deliveries (96%) among placenta previa cases.
